The Dead Lord thanks you for choosing him."

		"humans_race_disc"					"Humans - a race that has the advantage of armor and attack speed, pumping improvements people have all the chances to break an inattentive opponent. Use your advantage against the right opponent and then you will succeed. Bow down before your Lord (c)Arthas"

		"orcs_race_disc"					"Orcs - a race that allows you to destroy enemies to shreds, gaining a critical mass of orcs becomes almost unstoppable.
